meta.title: Maple Drive: My ads
meta.description: Creative monitoring tool for Maple Drive ads. Groups creatives by format, type (execution), and message angle. Metrics are left empty until ad account data is connected — do not pull Meta data until asked.
meta.watchlist_rule: Flag a creative when status is off or paused AND the chosen ROAS (Meta dashboard purchase ROAS, or payout ROAS if Meta ROAS is null) is at or above watchlist_roas_threshold.
meta.notes: This page is structure-only. All metric fields must stay null until Shayne asks to connect ad account data. Exclude anything named Cheaper (not Maple Drive). Approval/credit-friendly benefit ads must not use 'bad credit?' call-outs. Site is public on GitHub Pages.
meta.metrics_note: Top-ad rankings will use Meta dashboard purchase ROAS. Payout ROAS uses updated payouts. Both are stored separately.

angles.label: Payment-led offer
angles.description: A specific payment, bi-weekly amount, or payment-focused offer. Not competitor $170 bi-weekly claims.

angles.label: Credit-friendly / get approved
angles.description: Approval or credit-friendly benefit. Do not use 'bad credit?' call-outs.

angles.label: Inventory / in-stock cars
angles.description: Show the cars themselves, stock, or a specific vehicle.

angles.label: Drive away soon
angles.description: Speed to keys / start this week.

angles.label: Easy start / accessible terms
angles.description: Low barrier to start, clear terms, approachable offer.

angles.label: Lifestyle / next car
angles.description: Life with the car, 'your next car starts here' energy.

angles.label: Other
angles.description: Doesn't fit the angles above. Refine the list when classifying the first batch.
